title: Meta-Analysis — Forest Plots, Heterogeneity and Publication Bias

hook.en: A forest plot looks like an intimidating pile of squares and lines. It is actually the clearest picture in research: every study as a row, the result as a square, and the overall answer as a diamond. Learn to read it in thirty seconds, and to see when it should not be trusted.
hook.ur: Forest plot daraoni squares aur lakeeron ka dher lagta hai. Asal mein yeh research ki sab se saaf tasveer hai: har study ek qatar, nateeja ek square, aur kul jawab ek heera. Isay tees second mein parhna seekhein, aur dekhein kab is par bharosa nahi karna chahiye.

goal.en: By the end, you'll read a forest plot, explain pooled estimates and weighting, interpret I-squared as a measure of heterogeneity, choose between fixed-effect and random-effects reasoning, and recognise publication bias with a funnel plot.
goal.ur: End tak aap forest plot parhenge, pooled estimates aur weighting samjhayenge, I-squared ko heterogeneity ke naap ke taur par parhenge, fixed-effect aur random-effects mantiq mein se chunenge, aur funnel plot se publication bias pehchanenge.

text.en: A **meta-analysis** statistically combines results from several studies to give one overall estimate. Each study gets a **weight**, mostly based on its precision (larger studies count more). The **forest plot** shows each study's estimate with its confidence interval, a vertical line of **no effect**, and a diamond for the **pooled result**. **Heterogeneity** is the variation between studies beyond chance, often summarised by **I-squared**. **Publication bias** occurs when small studies with negative results are never published; a **funnel plot** can hint at it.
text.ur: **Meta-analysis** kai studies ke nateejon ko shumariyati taur par mila kar ek kul andaaza deta hai. Har study ko ek **weight** milta hai, zyada tar uski durusti par mabni (bade studies ka zyada). **Forest plot** har study ka andaaza uske confidence interval ke saath, **koi asar nahi** ki umoodi lakeer aur **pooled nateeje** ke liye heera dikhata hai. **Heterogeneity** studies ke beech ittifaq se zyada farq hai, jisay aksar **I-squared** se khulasa kiya jata hai. **Publication bias** tab hota hai jab manfi nateeje wale chhote studies kabhi shaya na hon; **funnel plot** is ka ishara de sakta hai.

text.en: Think of **asking ten friends how far the restaurant is**. Their answers differ. A meta-analysis averages them, listening more to those who walked it recently and carefully. If the answers range from 5 minutes to an hour, you would ask why before trusting the average. That "why" is heterogeneity.
text.ur: **Das doston se poochhna restaurant kitni door hai** sochein. Un ke jawab mukhtalif hain. Meta-analysis unka average nikalta hai, un ki zyada sunta hai jinhon ne haal mein aur ehtiyat se paidal chal kar dekha. Agar jawab 5 minute se ek ghante tak hon to average par bharosa se pehle aap poochhte kyun. Woh "kyun" heterogeneity hai.

title.en: How to read a forest plot, element by element
title.ur: Forest plot element ba element kaise parhein

rows.en: One study's estimate and its confidence interval
rows.ur: Ek study ka andaaza aur uska confidence interval

rows.en: A longer line means less precision; a bigger square means more weight
rows.ur: Lambi lakeer matlab kam durusti; bara square matlab zyada weight
Koi asar nahi ki umoodi lakeer
Farq ke liye 0, ratios ke liye 1

rows.en: An interval that crosses it is compatible with no effect
rows.ur: Jo interval isay paar kare woh asar na hone se mutabiq hai

rows.en: The pooled estimate; its width is its confidence interval
rows.ur: Pooled andaaza; uski chaudai uska confidence interval hai

rows.en: Check which side it falls on and whether it clears the minimal important change
rows.ur: Dekhein kis taraf girta hai aur kya minimal important change se aage hai

rows.en: The share of variation between studies that is beyond chance
rows.ur: Studies ke beech farq ka woh hissa jo ittifaq se aage ho

rows.en: Roughly 25 percent low, 50 moderate, 75 high (a rough guide); high values call for explanation
rows.ur: Takreeban 25 fisad kam, 50 darmiyana, 75 zyada (mota andaaza); zyada values wazahat maangti hain

question.en: A forest plot shows most squares on the left of the vertical line, with a pooled diamond entirely to the left, and the axis says "favours exercise" on the left. What is the interpretation?
question.ur: Forest plot mein zyada tar squares umoodi lakeer ke baayen taraf hain, pooled heera mukammal baayen taraf, aur axis par baayen taraf "exercise ke haq mein" likha hai. Is ki tafseer kya hai?

feedback.en: The label says the left favours exercise.
feedback.ur: Label kehta hai baayen taraf exercise ke haq mein hai.

feedback.en: The diamond does not touch the line of no effect.
feedback.ur: Heera asar na hone ki lakeer ko nahi chhoota.

text.en: Overall, the studies favour exercise, and the pooled interval excludes no effect; check the size against the minimal important change
text.ur: Kul mila kar studies exercise ke haq mein hain, aur pooled interval asar na hone ko khaarij karta hai; size ko minimal important change se milayein

feedback.en: Yes — direction is clear; importance still needs checking.
feedback.ur: Haan — rukh saaf hai; ahmiyat phir bhi jaanchni hai.

question.en: A meta-analysis reports an I-squared of 85 percent. What should you do?
question.ur: Meta-analysis ka I-squared 85 fisad report hota hai. Aap ko kya karna chahiye?

text.en: Trust the pooled result more because there are many studies
text.ur: Pooled nateeje par zyada bharosa karein kyunke bohat si studies hain

feedback.ur: Zyada heterogeneity yaqeen kam karti hai.

text.en: Be cautious about the pooled average and look for reasons the studies differ (patients, treatments, measures, quality)
text.ur: Pooled average par ehtiyat karein aur wajuhaat dhoondhein ke studies mukhtalif kyun hain (mareez, ilaaj, naap, quality)

feedback.en: Yes — high heterogeneity means a single average may not represent anyone.
feedback.ur: Haan — zyada heterogeneity ka matlab hai ke ek average kisi ki numaindagi nahi kar sakta.

text.ur: Meta-analysis ko dhoka keh kar radd karein

feedback.en: High I-squared is a signal to explore, not proof of fraud.
feedback.ur: Zyada I-squared tehqiq ka ishara hai, dhoke ka saboot nahi.

question.en: What might a funnel plot with a gap in the bottom left corner suggest?
question.ur: Neeche baayen kone mein khali jagah wala funnel plot kya ishara kar sakta hai?

text.en: Small studies with negative or null results may be missing, which suggests publication bias
text.ur: Manfi ya null nateeje wale chhote studies ghayab ho sakte hain, jo publication bias ka ishara hai

feedback.en: Yes — asymmetry may point to missing studies, though it can have other causes.
feedback.ur: Haan — asymmetry ghayab studies ki taraf ishara kar sakti hai, halaanke is ki doosri wajuhaat bhi ho sakti hain.
Asymmetry yaksaniyat ke baare mein nahi.
Khali jagah masle ka ishara hai.

text.en: **Believing a meta-analysis is automatically best evidence.** "Garbage in, garbage out": pooling biased or very different studies gives a precise but misleading average. Check whether the review had a registered protocol, a comprehensive search, risk-of-bias assessment and a sensible reason for pooling. Also, do not treat the pooled number as the effect for every patient; look at the spread between studies.
text.ur: **Yeh samajhna ke meta-analysis khud-ba-khud behtareen saboot hai.** "Kachra andar, kachra bahar": biased ya bohat mukhtalif studies ko mila kar durust lekin gumrah karne wala average milta hai. Dekhein ke review ka registered protocol, jame search, risk-of-bias ka jaiza aur milane ki munasib wajah thi ya nahi. Pooled number ko har mareez ke liye asar na samjhein; studies ke beech phailao dekhein.

text.en: **Use the diamond and the question.** Ask: does the diamond clear the smallest change that matters? Are the patients in the review like mine? How different were the studies? A well-run meta-analysis is a great starting point for patient conversations, but your patient is an individual, so use the average as a guide, not a promise.
text.ur: **Heere aur sawal ka istemal karein.** Poochhein: kya heera us sab se chhoti tabdeeli se aage hai jo ahem hai? Kya review ke mareez mere mareez jaise hain? Studies kitni mukhtalif thin? Achhi tarah chalaya gaya meta-analysis mareezon se baat ke liye behtareen aaghaz hai, lekin aap ka mareez ek shakhs hai, isliye average ko rehnumai samjhein, waada nahi.

question.en: What is the difference between fixed-effect and random-effects meta-analysis?
question.ur: Fixed-effect aur random-effects meta-analysis mein kya farq hai?

answer.en: A fixed-effect model assumes all studies estimate the same true effect and that differences are due only to chance. A random-effects model assumes the true effect varies across studies (different patients, treatments, settings) and estimates the average of these effects, with wider intervals. In rehabilitation, where studies differ a lot, random-effects reasoning is usually more realistic.
answer.ur: Fixed-effect model maanta hai ke saari studies ek hi asal asar ka andaaza lagati hain aur farq sirf ittifaq se hai. Random-effects model maanta hai ke asal asar studies mein mukhtalif hai (mukhtalif mareez, ilaaj, jagahein) aur in asaron ke average ka andaaza lagata hai, zyada chaudi intervals ke saath. Rehabilitation mein jahan studies bohat mukhtalif hoti hain, random-effects mantiq aam taur par zyada haqeeqat pasand hai.

beats.patient: A meta-analysis of 12 trials finds that supervised exercise reduces pain by 8 points (95 percent CI 5 to 11) compared with usual care, with I-squared 72 percent. The minimal important change is 10 points.
beats.assessment: The pooled effect is statistically clear but just below the minimal important change, and heterogeneity is high.
beats.treatment: She reads the subgroup analyses: studies of longer programmes and group classes show larger effects, and she checks whether those fit her clinic.
beats.reassess: She recommends supervised group exercise for patients, explains that the benefit is moderate on average and larger for some, and agrees on how they will check progress in six weeks.

text.en: **A pooled average can hide harm.** A meta-analysis of benefit may not have enough data on adverse events, or events may be reported differently. Look specifically for harm data. If there are only a few studies reporting harms, say so, and be cautious with higher-risk patients.
text.ur: **Pooled average nuqsan chhupa sakta hai.** Faide ka meta-analysis shayad adverse events par kaafi data na rakhta ho, ya events mukhtalif tareeqe se report hue hon. Nuqsan ke data ko khaas taur par dhoondhein. Agar sirf chand studies nuqsan report karti hon to yeh kahein, aur zyada khatre wale mareezon ke saath ehtiyat karein.

text.en: Higgins and colleagues proposed I-squared to describe the percentage of variation across studies that is due to heterogeneity rather than chance, with values of around 25, 50 and 75 percent suggesting low, moderate and high heterogeneity, while stressing that interpretation depends on the context. Sterne and colleagues recommended that funnel plots be used only when there are at least ten studies and that asymmetry has several possible causes, not only publication bias.
text.ur: Higgins aur saathiyon ne I-squared ko studies ke beech farq ka woh fisad bayan karne ke liye tajweez kiya jo ittifaq ke bajaye heterogeneity ki wajah se ho, jis mein takreeban 25, 50 aur 75 fisad ki values kam, darmiyani aur zyada heterogeneity ka ishara dete hain, aur zor diya ke tafseer context par munhasir hai. Sterne aur saathiyon ne sifarish ki ke funnel plots sirf tab istemal hon jab kam az kam das studies hon aur ke asymmetry ki kai mumkina wajuhaat hain, sirf publication bias nahi.

text.en: **Square, Line, Diamond, I-squared.** Read each study (square), the line of no effect, the pooled diamond, and how different the studies are (I-squared).
text.ur: **Square, Lakeer, Heera, I-squared.** Har study (square), asar na hone ki lakeer, pooled heera aur studies kitni mukhtalif hain (I-squared) parhein.

summary.en: A meta-analysis pools study results with weights; the forest plot shows each study and a pooled diamond.
summary.ur: Meta-analysis studies ke nateeje weights se milata hai; forest plot har study aur pooled heera dikhata hai.

summary.en: High I-squared means studies differ a lot, so be careful with the average and look for reasons.
summary.ur: Zyada I-squared ka matlab studies bohat mukhtalif hain, isliye average par ehtiyat karein aur wajuhaat dhoondhein.

summary.en: Publication bias can hide small negative studies; a meta-analysis is only as good as the studies and methods behind it.
summary.ur: Publication bias chhote manfi studies chhupa sakta hai; meta-analysis utna hi achha hai jitni studies aur methods us ke peechay hain.
